summary: Inspected 18 files across the TNLean/MPS/Periodic/ directory and subdirectories. All files contain formal mathematical content (definitions, theorems, lemmas, proofs) related to the periodic MPS formalization of arXiv:1708.00029. Four files (SectorIrreducibility.lean, Symmetry.lean, Overlap/SectorMatch.lean, Overlap.lean) are pure import aggregators generated by scripts/generate_import_aggregators.py. Per FILTER-007, these are navigation data that should be ranked down, not hard-filtered; they retain module identity, import edges, and provenance. Per FILTER-002 and FILTER-004, hard exclusion requires content-level evidence of no unique searchable formal mathematics, which is not met here. All files remain searchable.
